entries.title: A phase boundary drawn at the wrong place
entries.summary: ⚠⚠ **`_TSCONFIG_SKIP_DIRS` was the FOURTH copy of a skip list in this tree, and the only one that derived from nothing.** `security._SKIP_DIRECTORY_NAMES` is the authority -- CLAUDE.md says so, and `SKIP_DIRECTORIES` and `SKIP_PATTERNS` already derive from it -- but this set was hand-maintained beside it and had never heard

entries.title: A count taken after the page, and a field nobody read
entries.summary: `get_untested_symbols` computed `untested_count = len(symbols)` **after** the `max_results` slice, and derived `reached_pct` from it. `get_repo_health` calls it with `max_results=1` under the comment *"we only need the count"*.

entries.title: Only the reader was never fixed
entries.summary: Step 2c read `uv run --python 3.13 python -m pytest tests/ -q`. CI runs `uv sync --locked --group dev --extra watch` first. The documented command synced nothing and named no extra, so it **inherited whatever `.venv` happened to hold** -- it looked correct for exactly as long as a previous sync's packages
